leo_marketing: Quick sync  eu-central showing increased 503s for gen endpoints. Need final statuspage copy + guidance for AE/CS routing. Want to avoid mass emails unless SLA customers impacted. Thoughts?

jin_sre: We're throttling and failing over some pods. Root cause still unknown. Suggest timeline: post "Investigating" now, update at 30m with progress, "Service degraded  Mitigated" when error rate <2% for 5m, then RCA doc in 24h.

tara_pd: For marketing copy, keep it short and actionable. Console banner + status page first, then targeted email to accounts showing >1k requests/min in last hour.

leo_marketing: Draft statusline options:
```
Investigating: We're seeing elevated errors for inference in eu-central. Engineers are working on a fix. Real-time updates: https://status.redwood.ai
```

nina_cs: For CS routing: please tag tickets with "eu-central-outage" and escalate accounts above spend threshold. I'll ping AEs for those customers. Also set up a one-click ops call template in the email.

ezra_sales: Add a short note for prospects in chatbots/webforms: "We're currently experiencing degraded performance in EU. For urgent evaluation, request a demo or try Dedicated capacity."

jin_sre: Note: do NOT promise credits in public copy. If we offer credits, keep it private via AE/CS.

leo_marketing: Email template draft (targeted):
```
Subject: Redwood Alert 3 eu-central degraded performance

Hi <FirstName>,

We're experiencing degraded inference performance in the eu-central region affecting generation and embeddings. Our team is actively investigating. If you're seeing impact, reply to this message to get a prioritized ops call; your ticket: <TICKET_LINK>.

If you need immediate stability, we can help route traffic to Dedicated or to another region.

Thanks,
Redwood Inference Ops
```

tara_pd: Good. Add one line about "no data loss observed" if ops confirms.

jin_sre: Confirmed: no data loss observed. Add that line.

statusbot: Incident INC-2026-214 created by jin_sre at 1899990012.
